title: On-behalf-of token exchange for Lighthouse tools
scenario: A Lighthouse tool forwards the manager's gateway token to the access-requests API, which rejects it on audience; a service account would make the agent a confused deputy. Implement RFC 8693 token exchange so the API sees the user as subject and the agent as actor, with narrowed scope, verified responses and a safe cache. Offline fake IdP.
task: Validate inbound JWTs: algorithm allow-list, kid, issuer, audience, expiry
Build the RFC 8693 request with scope narrowing and an actor token
Verify the issued token: audience, subject, scope, actor
Cache per user, target and scope; refresh before expiry
acceptance: API sees the user with the agent as actor; replayed user token fails
Misbehaving IdP responses and forged tokens are rejected
ANSWER.md maps the flow onto AgentCore Identity
